rounds.q: What % of US shopping dollars are spent online?
rounds.why: Online sales hit $340 billion in just three months, up 12% from a year earlier.
rounds.src: US Census Bureau, Quarterly Retail E-Commerce Sales (Q2 2026 data)
rounds.fun: About 17 cents of every shopping dollar is spent online. That is a lot of clicking!

rounds.q: How many days did the Pony Express take to carry mail across the West?
rounds.why: The 1,800-mile ride from Missouri to California was in business for only 18 months.
rounds.src: US Postal Service, Postal Facts: Pony Express history (1860-61)
rounds.fun: Ten days over 1,800 miles, and the whole thing only lasted 18 months. Giddy up!

rounds.q: What year did the US start using ZIP codes?
rounds.why: Within four years, 8 out of 10 Americans knew who the mascot Mr. ZIP was.
rounds.src: US Postal Service, Postal Facts: Size and scope (ZIP Code introduced July 1, 1963)
rounds.fun: ZIP codes arrived in 1963, and Mr. ZIP was famous within four years!

rounds.q: How many post office locations are there in the US?
rounds.why: The Postal Service also runs 236,347 delivery routes and 262,740 vehicles.
rounds.src: US Postal Service, Postal Facts: total retail offices (fiscal 2025 data)
rounds.fun: 30,972 post offices and 262,740 vehicles. That is one busy mail machine!

rounds.q: How many billion pieces of mail does the US Postal Service handle in a year?
rounds.why: The exact count was 105.1 billion, and more than half, 56 billion, was marketing mail.
rounds.src: US Postal Service, Fiscal Year 2026 Results (year ended Sept 30, 2026)
rounds.fun: 105 billion pieces in a year, and more than half was marketing mail. Sorry, mailbox!
